messages.subject: deployApp()/server problem or nlopt problem?
parts:
Hi, 
 
 I just tried to deploy a particular shiny application with deployApp('/asdf/'), but I receive the following error:

Preparing to deploy application...
(…)
nlopt-2.4.2/util/Makefile.am
n################################### End Log ################################### 
Erro: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 1062855 error: Unhandled Exception: [Errno 13] Permission denied: '/opt/rstudio-lucid/work/lucid-builder/build/images/task-1062855-7aMFNQ/nlopt-2.4.2/COPYING'

 I wonder if this is a problem with the nlopt package or with the Shiny server…
 
 Cheers,
 
 Alberto.
